exposure: labor onset before planned cesarean delivery
cohort: Singleton term pregnant women with intended cesarean delivery at Aarhus University Hospital from 1990 to 2012
finding: Labor onset before planned cesarean delivery was not associated with a decrease in neonatal respiratory morbidity, but may be associated with an increased risk of neonatal infection.
mod_finding: Labor onset before a planned cesarean delivery was not associated with a decrease in neonatal respiratory morbidity, but it may be associated with increased risks of neonatal infection.
